summary: Digital asset wealth and yield platform that suspended all activity in June 2024 and entered insolvent liquidation after losses linked to assets held through third-party hedge fund managers on FTX.
what_happened: Yield App publicly launched in February 2021 as a digital asset wealth platform offering yield products. On 28 June 2024 it announced the suspension of all platform activity ahead of liquidation, citing realized portfolio losses through third-party hedge fund managers that had held assets on FTX. Yield App Limited entered insolvent liquidation effective 1 July 2024, with joint liquidators appointed from Cork Gully LLP. In 2025 the liquidators reported an interim creditor distribution and later published Seychelles court guidance on the treatment of extensively commingled customer cryptoassets.
uncertainty_notes: The liquidation remains ongoing. Final customer recovery depends on additional asset realization, litigation and claim treatment. The court guidance also leaves a narrow possibility that some assets never swept into pooled wallets may receive different proprietary treatment.
notes: Updated with 2025 liquidator distribution reporting and court guidance on commingled cryptoassets.
